subject: GSI partnership — next-step deep dive & attendee confirmation
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@cloudhaven.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leah Torres <leah.torres@stratcloud.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + request for technical deep dive

Marcus — thanks again for the intro call earlier. CloudHaven is excited about the Redwood inference flow and the idea of a marketplace path with a GSI-led go-to-market. A couple of asks from our side so we can scope internal approvals: 

- We'd like a 60–75 minute technical deep dive next week that includes networking/security, quantized model footprint, and latency profiles for 1k concurrents.
- Key attendees: myself (GSI BD), Leah (Cloud architect), and our procurement lead (TBD).

Do you have availability next Wed/Thu afternoon (US/PST)? If the deep dive needs a couple of Redwood engineers, please loop them in so we can make the session productive. Also: can you share a short agenda and any pre-reads?

Thanks — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships, CloudHaven
amit@cloudhaven.com
+1 (415) 555-0168

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + request for technical deep dive

Amit — great to hear from you and glad the intro was helpful. Short recap and proposal: 

Recap from discovery: 
- CloudHaven interested in marketplace integration for GSI reseller flow and predictable latency for enterprise customers.
- Primary concerns: VPC/private deployment options, per-tenant isolation, and throughput at scale.

Proposed next steps: 
1) 75-minute technical deep dive (network/security + perf + quantization tradeoffs).
2) Internal attendees from Redwood: myself (product lead), Camila (solutions/tech lead), and Ben (partner engineering).
3) Proposed slots (PST): Wed 2026-09-16 2:00–3:15pm, Thu 2026-09-17 10:00–11:15am, Thu 2026-09-17 3:30–4:45pm.

I've attached a draft agenda and a short ask list — feel free to add items. If those times don't work, send your availability and we can iterate. I'll also drop a calendar poll if you prefer.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@cloudhaven.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + request for technical deep dive

Amit / Marcus — adding a few technical notes so the deep dive can be targeted: 

- Suggested agenda (attached in the PDF Marcus shared): 1) Integration patterns (marketplace + GSI flow) 2) Network topology & VPC peering options 3) Per-tenant isolation and key management 4) Performance profiles + live demo (if we allocate 15 mins for a quick perf run) 5) Q&A and next-step action items.
- Pre-read request: if CloudHaven can share expected concurrency targets (p50/p95), average sequence length, and whether customers will require private deployment (VPC) vs hosted API, we can tailor perf numbers.
- Note on constraints: CloudHaven mentioned a firewall that only allows outbound TLS 443 — if true, we'll need to validate mutual TLS or a proxy pattern. I've attached a sample network diagram we use for reference.

Happy to lead the perf segment; linking in Ben for any infra-specific items.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
